title: Guidance or help to generate consistent art for paperdoll mixing and matching gear / weapons
author: pgermishuys
selftext:
I am looking for some guidance or help as I'm attempting to work on a arpg, think Diablo, PoE where the player can wear different types of gear ( plate helm, leather tunic and cloth boots ) and whether anyone has found a nice way to layer on those pieces of gear and or weapons where its worked nicely.

I have tried

\- 3d model with blender and then painted on the gear

\- just painting everything

there is always slight glitches,etc

Tools ive used 

\- spritecook

\- pixellab with their animations, etc

replies.author: pgermishuys
replies.body: Im referring to the player character itself

replies.author: Outrageous-Issue9722
replies.body:
Which engine? 
The easy/expensive way to do it (in Godot) is to use boneSockets on the player then just parent the equipment to the socket when you equip it. There are much better ways to go about it, but for non-mmo scale that is plenty

replies.author: pgermishuys
replies.body: what about creating/generating art? the problem im also having is for example mixing plate pants with cloth boots, plate chest plate with a leather gloves. Perhaps i'm missing something obvious about having prefabs that just always works together
